niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on whether you want a Jungian approach, a guided personal-growth course, or a broader spiritual practice. These are good starting points based on the available course information:

### Shadow work
- **[Encounters with the Shadow — Jung Platform](https://jungplatform.com/store/encounters-with-the-shadow/partner/jrose)** — A substantial introduction to Jungian shadow work. A good fit if you want concepts and reflection grounded in Jungian psychology.
- **[Engage the Shadow — Jung Platform](https://jungplatform.com/course/engage-the-shadow)** — Combines video and audio lessons with practical techniques. Consider it if you want more guided exercises.
- **[Shadow Mastery — Centre of Excellence](https://www.centreofexcellence.com/shop/shadow-mastery-diploma-course/)** — Ten self-paced modules, suited to learners who prefer a structured, independent course.
- **[Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate Your Shadow Self — Udemy](https://www.udemy.com/course/shadow_work/)** — Self-paced with lifetime access after purchase. Check the instructor’s background, curriculum, and recent reviews before enrolling.

### Spiritual practice
- **[Mindfulness: What It Is, Where It Comes From, and How to Practice It — Naropa University / The Awake Network](https://www.naropa.edu/academics/personal-enrichment/)** — A free introduction that connects mindfulness practice with its Buddhist roots.
- **[Mindful.org courses](https://www.mindful.org/courses/)** — Self-paced mindfulness and meditation options; useful if you want practical exercises without committing to one religious tradition.
- **[Rice University: Mindfulness and Well-Being](https://online.rice.edu/courses/mindfulness-and-well-being-peace-in-peace-out)** — A self-paced course listed at about five weeks and five hours per week.
- **[Mindworks meditation courses](https://mindworks.org/meditation-courses/)** — Guided courses in mindfulness and Buddhist meditation, with lessons and practices for different experience levels.
- **[Shalem: Closer Than Breath](https://shalem.org/programs/offerings-by-shalem-graduates/)** — A self-paced course in Centering Prayer, an explicitly Christian contemplative practice.

**A sensible path:** Start with Naropa’s free mindfulness course or a beginner meditation course, then choose one shadow-work course that matches your preferred approach. Shadow work can bring up difficult emotions; it’s not a substitute for therapy, and it’s wise to pause or seek support if the exercises feel destabilizing. Check current fees, access periods, and instructor qualifications on each course page before buying.
